commitments.detail: Implement the event-ingestion service using the proposed streaming architecture.
Implement the event-ingestion service using the streaming architecture as it passed the functional test suite.
Ensure data is ingested and processed in real-time for immediate event handling.
Implement with 8 partitions to handle expected load and allow for future scaling.
Deploy in us-east-1 to meet regional compliance requirements.
Retain data for 7 days to comply with data retention policies.
Ensure data is processed within seconds of ingestion.
Support up to 100,000 events per second.
Achieve at least 99.9% uptime across all nodes.
